-- Phase 1: spec only. Bodies are left as `unreachable`.

-- Pure formatter: builds the log line text. Needs no capabilities.
format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out == "[\(level)] \(message)"
  ex format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

-- Prints one formatted log line to stdout. Uses only `io`; it never touches `fs`.
log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  io.print(format_line(level: level, message: message))
